1	# BatchRename — small PowerShell module used to learn the thien workflow.
2	Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
3	
4	function ConvertTo-SafeFileName {
5	    <#
6	    .SYNOPSIS
7	      Replace characters that are invalid in Windows file names with '_' and trim spaces/dots.
8	    #>
9	    [CmdletBinding()]
10	    param([Parameter(Mandatory, ValueFromPipeline)][string]$Name)
11	    process {
12	        $invalid = [System.IO.Path]::GetInvalidFileNameChars() + [char[]]'<>:"/\|?*'
13	        $chars = $Name.ToCharArray() | ForEach-Object { if ($invalid -contains $_) { '_' } else { $_ } }
14	        (-join $chars).Trim().TrimEnd('.')
15	    }
16	}
17	
18	Export-ModuleMember -Function ConvertTo-SafeFileName
19

2	Assert-Equal 'safe: trims trailing dot and space' 'report' (ConvertTo-SafeFileName ' report. ')
3	Assert-Equal 'safe: unchanged' 'hello.txt' (ConvertTo-SafeFileName 'hello.txt')

2	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
3	$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
4	$errors = @()

11	Import-Module (Join-Path $root 'src/BatchRename.psm1') -Force -DisableNameChecking

# Build = parse every .ps1/.psm1 and import the module once. Exit 1 on any error.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$errors = @()
Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Recurse -Include *.ps1, *.psm1 -File | ForEach-Object {
    $t = $null; $e = $null
    [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($_.FullName, [ref]$t, [ref]$e) | Out-Null
    if ($e) { $errors += $e | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Extent.File):$($_.Extent.StartLineNumber): $($_.Message)" } }
}
if ($errors) { $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "PARSE ERROR $_" }; exit 1 }
Import-Module (Join-Path $root 'src/BatchRename.psm1') -Force -DisableNameChecking
$exported = (Get-Module BatchRename).ExportedFunctions.Keys -join ', '
Write-Output "build ok: exported $exported"
exit 0

# AC-1: renames matching files only (not folders, not non-matching files) and returns OldName/NewName
$d = New-TestFolder
'a1.txt', 'a2.txt', 'b.txt' | ForEach-Object { New-Item -ItemType File -Path (Join-Path $d $_) | Out-Null }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $d 'a3') | Out-Null
$r = @(Rename-ByPattern -Path $d -Pattern '^a' -Replacement 'x' | Sort-Object OldName)
Assert-Equal 'rename: result count' 2 $r.Count
Assert-Equal 'rename: first OldName' 'a1.txt' $r[0].OldName
Assert-Equal 'rename: first NewName' 'x1.txt' $r[0].NewName
Assert-Equal 'rename: second OldName' 'a2.txt' $r[1].OldName
Assert-Equal 'rename: second NewName' 'x2.txt' $r[1].NewName
Assert-True 'rename: x1.txt exists' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'x1.txt'))
Assert-True 'rename: x2.txt exists' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'x2.txt'))
Assert-True 'rename: a1.txt gone' (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'a1.txt')))
Assert-True 'rename: b.txt untouched' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'b.txt'))

Assert-Equal 'whatif: NewName' 'x1.txt' $r[0].NewName
Assert-True 'whatif: a1.txt still exists' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'a1.txt'))
Assert-True 'whatif: x1.txt not created' (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'x1.txt')))

# AC-3 (a): two files would get the same new name
$d = New-TestFolder
'a1.txt', 'b1.txt' | ForEach-Object { New-Item -ItemType File -Path (Join-Path $d $_) | Out-Null }
$msg = ''
try { Rename-ByPattern -Path $d -Pattern '^[ab]' -Replacement 'c' | Out-Null } catch { $msg = $_.Exception.Message }
Assert-True 'collision dup: message' ($msg -like '*Name collision*')
Assert-True 'collision dup: a1.txt kept' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'a1.txt'))
Assert-True 'collision dup: b1.txt kept' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'b1.txt'))
Assert-True 'collision dup: c1.txt not created' (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'c1.txt')))

# AC-3 (b): the new name already exists

$msg = ''
try { Rename-ByPattern -Path $d -Pattern '^a' -Replacement 'x' | Out-Null } catch { $msg = $_.Exception.Message }
Assert-True 'collision exists: message' ($msg -like '*Name collision*')
Assert-True 'collision exists: a1.txt kept' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'a1.txt'))
Assert-True 'collision exists: x1.txt kept' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'x1.txt'))
Assert-Equal 'collision exists: file count' 2 @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -File).Count

# AC-4: the new name goes through ConvertTo-SafeFileName

Assert-True 'safe name: a_b.txt exists' (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d 'a_b.txt'))
